business_problem: Camplify needed an application and analytics platform that could absorb sudden traffic spikes, support rapid mobile and product delivery, and produce better customer insight as its campervan-rental marketplace expanded internationally.
solution_summary: Camplify uses AWS to scale both its marketplace application and its analytics environment as the business grows across multiple countries. Customer-facing workloads run on AWS Fargate and AWS Elastic Beanstalk, with Amazon RDS and related cloud infrastructure supporting the underlying application data. This lets the platform react automatically to abrupt demand spikes—such as large bursts after television advertising—without manual intervention. Alongside the application tier, Camplify uses an AWS-based analytics platform to study customer behavior and inform new features, and it is exploring Amazon SageMaker for recommendation engines. The combined application-and-data architecture gives Camplify a more elastic digital foundation, shortens mobile development cycles, supports growth in app downloads, and gives the company better visibility into how travelers use the service.

solution_components.name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
solution_components.role: Runs application environments that support Camplify's continuous growth.

data_flow: Customer traffic is served through AWS Fargate and Elastic Beanstalk application environments, application data is stored in Amazon RDS, and usage data is analyzed in Camplify's AWS-based analytics platform to generate insights and future recommendations.
business_outcome: Camplify handled a 4,000 percent hourly traffic spike automatically, cut mobile app design and deployment time to 6 weeks, supported a 3x increase in app downloads, and uses analytics to inform new customer experiences and future recommendation engines.
